name: marketsuite-store-workspace
description: MarketSuite: management portal (existing) + customer-facing Store (new). Two separate apps.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix management/server install && npm --prefix management/client install && npm --prefix store install
scripts.check:store: npm --prefix store run lint && npm --prefix store run test && npm --prefix store run build
scripts.check:management: npm --prefix management/server run test:unit && npm --prefix management/server run test:routes && npm --prefix management/client run build
scripts.check: npm run check:management && npm run check:store
